common_character.candidate_weld: identify Frobenius parity on the V2 semilinear clock with the G2 outer-extension parity

theorem: The shared C13 clock has a canonical binary orientation character C12 -> C2 with kernel C6. On G2(4):2 this character is exactly the outer involution quotient; on the abstract V2 Singer normalizer it is Frobenius parity. Thus a C2 orientation bit is intrinsic to the clock normalizer rather than attached ad hoc.
